StreamDestination.title: StreamDestination
StreamDestination.description: A configured RTMP/RTMPS live streaming destination such as YouTube Live, Facebook Live, Instagram Live, or a custom ingest server.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning creator.

label.description: Display name for this stream destination (1-60 chars).

rtmpUrl.description: RTMP or RTMPS ingest server URL (7-300 chars).

streamKey.description: Secret stream key issued by the target platform (0-256 chars).

enabled.description: Whether this destination is toggled on for simultaneous broadcast.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

BroadcastSession.title: BroadcastSession
BroadcastSession.description: A record of a multi-platform live broadcast session and its real-time telemetry summary.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning creator.

title.description: Title of the broadcast session (1-120 chars).

videoCount.description: Number of uploaded videos queued in this broadcast (1-100).

platforms.description: List of platform identifiers targeted in this broadcast (1-10 items).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the broadcast session.

totalBytesSent.description: Total payload bytes transmitted across all platforms.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

NewsDeskPreset.title: NewsDeskPreset
NewsDeskPreset.description: Saved news desk configuration and bulletin preset with channel branding, breaking headline, scrolling ticker, and TTS presenter script.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning broadcaster.

channelName.description: News channel name displayed in the top broadcast bug (1-40 chars).

headline.description: Primary breaking news headline displayed in the lower-third bar (0-140 chars).

tickerText.description: Bottom continuously scrolling news ticker text (0-1000 chars).

newsScript.description: Auto-read news presentation script for TTS narration (0-4000 chars).

ttsLanguage.description: Voice language code for the automated news presenter.

tickerSpeed.description: Horizontal scroll speed preset for the bottom news ticker.

newsModeEnabled.description: Whether the TV news overlay compositor is active during broadcast.

ttsEnabled.description: Whether automated TTS news narration audio is mixed into the live stream.

showLogo.description: Whether the top channel logo and LIVE clock bug are visible.

showTicker.description: Whether the bottom scrolling news ticker is visible.

showHeadline.description: Whether the lower-third breaking news headline bar is visible.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

/users/{userId}/destinations/{destinatio.description: User-owned RTMP/RTMPS broadcast destinations for YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and custom targets.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: User-owned multi-platform broadcast session history and live telemetry logs.

/users/{userId}/newsPresets/{presetId}.description: User-owned news desk graphics settings, scrolling tickers, and automated TTS news bulletins.
